pages.text: Rest beside a lit bonfire for five seconds and six $(l)runes$() rise around the fire. Right-click one to raise that stat, paying in $(l)experience levels$(). The price rises with your $(l)Soul Level$(), shown under your name; the action bar tells you what the next level costs.

$(l)Vigor$(): health. $(l)Endurance$(): stamina. $(l)Strength$(): melee damage. $(l)Dexterity$(): attack speed. $(l)Attunement$(): mana. $(l)Intelligence$(): spell power. Twenty points each, at most.$(br2)Experience also pays for enchanting and the anvil. Choose.
